# Malpani M SoulStrings - Official Project Knowledge Base

> Malpani M SoulStrings is an ultra-luxury residential landmark situated on the Baner-Pashan Link Road, Pune West, Maharashtra, India. Developed by Malpani Estates (a division of the 30+ year Malpani Group), it offers expansive 3 BHK, 4 BHK, 5 BHK Sky Duplexes, and Sky Penthouses with 270-degree protected views of the Sus Hills.

## Key Facts & Project Metadata

- **Project Name**: Malpani M SoulStrings
- **Developer**: Malpani Estates (Malpani Group)
- **Official Website**: https://www.malpanimsoulstrings.com
- **Location**: Baner-Pashan Link Road, near Vighnaharta Chowk, Pashan/Baner, Pune, Maharashtra 411045, India
- **Coordinates**: 18.5449193° N, 73.7910949° E
- **Google Knowledge Graph ID**: `/g/11l2r1p7gl`
- **MahaRERA Registration Numbers**: 
  - Wing B: `P52100076782`
  - Wing C: `P52100055678`
- **Total Land Area**: 5.20 Acres
- **Total Residences**: 455 Exclusive Units (Ultra-Low Density)
- **Towers**: 4 High-Rise Towers (G + 26 Floors)
- **Starting Price**: ₹1.95 Crore (3 BHK) to ₹6.50 Crore+ (Sky Penthouses)

## Strategic Location & Commute Matrix

- **Balewadi High Street**: 8 Minutes (2.4 km) - Pune's premier dining and nightlife boulevard
- **Hinjewadi IT Park (Phase 1)**: 12 Minutes (8.2 km) - Via direct highway bypass
- **Mumbai-Pune Expressway**: 10 Minutes (1.1 km) - Direct access at Baner/Wakad
- **Jupiter Hospital & Manipal Clinic**: 8 Minutes (3.2 km) - Grade-A healthcare
- **The Orchid School & VIBGYOR High**: 5 to 10 Minutes - Top-tier education
- **Upcoming Pune Metro Line 3**: Accessible via Baner & Balewadi Metro stations

## Architectural Highlights & Amenities

- **100% Vastu Shastra Compliance**: East-West solar orientation, Agneya (South-East) modular kitchens, and Nairutya (South-West) master suites.
- **Construction Quality**: Monolithic Mivan aluminum formwork for superior earthquake resistance and seamless concrete joints.
- **Acoustic Insulation**: Double-Glazed Unit (DGU) windows for thermal insulation and zero ambient noise.
- **35+ Resort Amenities**: Temperature-controlled infinity pool, multi-level signature clubhouse, wellness spa, salon, private screening theater, squash court, badminton court, pickleball arena, and EV charging for every car park.
